actions.action: Time-box initial diagnosis and rotate uncertain jobs
actions.mechanism: A decision checkpoint prevents one uncertain item from holding a bench indefinitely; queue aging prevents repeated deferral.
actions.implementation: Review after 15 minutes: continue briefly, safely park, or escalate. Alternate screened short jobs with oldest deferred jobs. Only the specialist opens electrical equipment.
actions.check: Log bench occupancy and queue selections; flag any deferred item skipped across two eligible turns or diagnosis continued without review.
actions.risk: Safe stopping may exceed the checkpoint; record why.

actions.action: Separate parts waiting from bench-ready work
actions.mechanism: A distinct parts-waiting state removes unavailable-part jobs from the active queue without losing ownership or retrieval information.
actions.implementation: Use matching item tags and owner receipts. Record status, exact storage location, required part, and follow-up volunteer; return to ready only after part availability is confirmed.
actions.check: At shift end, reconcile every retained item against its receipt identifier and location; verify no parts-waiting item occupies a bench unnecessarily.
actions.risk: Limited safe storage may require owner collection instead.

actions.action: Screen eligibility before assigning a bench
actions.mechanism: Non-invasive intake separates safe general work from specialist-only work before scarce bench and specialist time are committed.
actions.implementation: Assign an existing volunteer to record symptoms and externally screen items without opening electrical equipment. Queue electrical openings exclusively for the specialist; record uncertain scope explicitly.
actions.check: Audit electrical-opening records for specialist assignment; sample queued general jobs for documented screening and reroute any ambiguous item.
actions.risk: Screening can miss hazards; uncertainty requires specialist review.

actions.action: Require an accepted handoff for every retained item
actions.mechanism: Explicit transfer of responsibility and a concrete next action prevent items becoming ownerless work between shifts.
actions.implementation: Record receipt ID, location, status, responsible volunteer, next action, and blocker. Incoming volunteers acknowledge transfers; omit completion promises unless an explicit uncertainty range accompanies them.
actions.check: At shift change, sample retained items: each must be locatable, have an acknowledged responsible person, and a specific next action.
actions.risk: Unaccepted transfers need resolution before the outgoing volunteer leaves.
